base: flat black acrylic, phthalo blue and sap green blended on top

steps.subject: other: light through trees
steps.action: tap white in for light shining through
steps.load: tap white into the bristles
steps.motion: back and forth, jiggle, let it pick up colors underneath
steps.where: upper canvas over the blue-green wash

steps.subject: other: light through trees
steps.action: light spots, then brush up and down
steps.motion: brush up and down very lightly
steps.where: light spots across the upper canvas

steps.subject: other: tree trunks
steps.action: lay in dark trunk shapes
steps.load: load the fan with the dark mix
steps.motion: touch down the canvas and work down

steps.subject: other: tree trunks
steps.action: far trees with less paint
steps.load: remove most paint from the brush
steps.motion: touch in small far trees
steps.rule: less paint makes the trees look farther away

steps.subject: other: distant leaves
steps.action: a few distant leaves on the far trees
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: touch small leaves here and there

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: pinkish highlights on the tree edges
steps.load: small roll of pink mix along the knife edge
steps.motion: touch, letting the canvas take what it wants
steps.where: edges of the trees, light side
steps.rule: light from the right is easier when right-handed

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: more pink on the back leaves to bring trees forward
steps.load: same knife roll
steps.motion: drop a little color on top of the back leaves
steps.where: back leaves at the top of the trees
steps.rule: placing color over the back trees brings them forward

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: very dark blue shadow side on the tree
steps.load: white and blue, mixed very dark
steps.motion: cut across, touch the shadow side

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: little shadow on the other side
steps.load: same knife roll
steps.motion: let it drop off the knife, just touch

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: near-white sparkles on the trunks
steps.load: almost straight white on the knife
steps.motion: barely touch in a few spots
steps.where: where the light hits the trunks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: black limbs with a script liner
steps.load: liner loaded with paint thinner, then black
steps.motion: turn the brush and pull limbs out
steps.where: on the trees, near the trunks
steps.rule: limbs are thicker where they join the trunk

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: limbs that push the trees back
steps.load: same liner
steps.motion: drop limbs in, some over the tops of the trees
steps.where: far trees and over the tops
steps.rule: limbs over the tops push everything back

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dark fan leaf marks for evergreen leaves
steps.load: fan brush with black, thinner if it does not stick
steps.motion: touch the canvas and let the fan work
steps.rule: thin paint or thin oil helps paint stick

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: highlights on the evergreen leaves
steps.load: cad yellow and sap green on the fan
steps.motion: a few highlights, lightly placed
steps.rule: too many highlights kill the dark and flatten the painting

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: few leaf marks on the other side
steps.load: fan brush with black and a little thinner
steps.motion: drop in a few indications
steps.rule: thin paint sticks to the thick first layer

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: throw dark color into the lower bushes
steps.load: black on the fan brush
steps.motion: throw it in, no distinct shapes
steps.where: lower part of the canvas, bushes

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: sap green and cad yellow highlights on bush bases
steps.load: a little paint thinner, then sap green and cad yellow
steps.motion: touch and tap small highlights

steps.subject: land
steps.action: soft grassy areas with greens and yellows
steps.load: mix the greens and yellows on the brush
steps.motion: tap in soft grassy areas

steps.subject: land
steps.action: tap bright areas to soften and darken
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: keep tapping the bright areas
steps.rule: tapping picks up the color underneath and darkens it

steps.subject: water
steps.action: puddle with blue and white pulled down
steps.load: white with left-over blue
steps.motion: pull straight down, then go across very lightly

steps.subject: land
steps.action: dirt indications with the knife
steps.load: mix van dyke brown and burnt umber on the knife
steps.motion: drop in little indications

steps.subject: other: grey wash
steps.action: grey wash barely touched
steps.load: brown, white and a touch of blue into a grey
steps.motion: barely touch, caress the canvas

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: thin blue and white water lines
steps.load: a little blue and white on the knife
steps.motion: touch in water lines here and there
steps.where: under the puddle, along the edges
steps.rule: not overmixing lets colors happen on their own

steps.subject: land
steps.action: bring the grass color together
steps.load: the same grass mix on the brush
steps.motion: bring it together, tapping across the puddle

steps.subject: water
steps.action: more puddles across the canvas
steps.load: same brush with a little white and blue
steps.motion: pull down and go across

steps.subject: land
steps.action: warm yellow ochre and permanent red touch
steps.load: a little yellow ochre and a small touch of permanent red
steps.motion: tap in the warm color

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: brighter reflection with a little white
steps.load: a little white on the brush
steps.motion: pull down, then go across
steps.rule: a little white makes light look like it hits there

steps.subject: land
steps.action: brown dirt around the puddle
steps.load: brown on the brush
steps.motion: dab some dirt around

steps.subject: land
steps.action: pink touch on the puddle
steps.load: pink leftover from the palette
steps.motion: drop a little highlight on

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: pull dark trees down over the bush
steps.load: dark color from the trees
steps.motion: pull straight down over the bush
steps.where: trees in front of the bush

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: grass around the tree feet
steps.load: grass color on the fan
steps.motion: a few grassy areas around the feet
steps.where: base of the trees, around the puddle

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: blue and white water lines to clean edges
steps.load: little blue and white on the knife
steps.motion: cut across and drop straight lines
steps.rule: water lines clean up the edges

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: grass coming down to the water
steps.load: grass color on the fan
steps.motion: let grass come down
steps.rule: grass breaks up the straight line

steps.subject: land
steps.action: brown dirt at the water edges
steps.load: brown on the knife
steps.motion: dab dirt around the edges

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big dark tree in the scene
steps.load: dark color on the fan
steps.motion: touch in a big tree
steps.rule: a big tree closer to us pushes everything back

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big roots at the tree base
steps.load: same dark color
steps.motion: drop in big roots
steps.rule: the roots hold the tree up

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big arms reaching out
steps.load: paint thinner on the brush, then dark color
steps.motion: pull out arms, up the tree
steps.where: arms on the big tree, into the water

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight color down the big tree
steps.load: a little crimson, permanent red and white
steps.motion: let it come down the tree
steps.where: up and down the big tree

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: shadow and reflection under the tree
steps.load: same mix
steps.motion: drop shadow, a little in the reflection
steps.where: below the tree in the water

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull the reflection down and go across
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: pull down very lightly, then go across
steps.where: water under the tree and puddles
